# KitzAlpen – Kitzbühel Alpen Pension & Chalet

> Guesthouse with restaurant and a self-contained chalet in Hollersbach im Pinzgau (Salzburg, Austria), about 2 km from the Panoramabahn gondola into the KitzSki ski area and inside the Hohe Tauern National Park region. Website in German (root) and English, Dutch, Romanian, Hungarian, Czech, Polish and Swedish.

## Facts
- Address: Reitlehen 42, 5731 Hollersbach im Pinzgau, Salzburg, Austria (47.27268, 12.42573)
- Phone / WhatsApp: +43 664 2376571 · Email: kitzbuhelalpenpension@gmail.com
- Guesthouse: 17 rooms in 4 categories, each with a private bathroom with shower
  - Double room (8 rooms, 15–21 m², up to 2 guests)
  - Triple room (3 rooms, 17–24 m², up to 3 guests)
  - Family room with connecting door (4 rooms, 19–31 m², up to 4 guests; connected up to 8)
  - Four-bed room (2 rooms, 19–31 m², up to 4 guests)
- Chalet: self-contained house for up to 4 guests, 2 bedrooms, fully equipped kitchen, bathroom with WC
- Restaurant & bar: breakfast buffet daily 8–10 am; dinner buffet Tuesday–Sunday 5–9 pm
- Free Wi-Fi, free parking, ski room with boot dryers, mountain view
- Guests receive the M+ Guest Card and the Guest Mobility Ticket (free buses and trains in the province of Salzburg)
- Booking (rooms): https://kitzbuhel.pynbooking.direct · Booking (chalet): https://chalet-kitzalpen.pynbooking.direct/
